intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Main Street. The city bus runs exactly on time, but its driver has been ticked. He won't open the doors because that's "not on the beat."

intro.speaker: The Straight Man
intro.text: One. Two. Three. Four. Passengers will remain seated. One. Two. Three. Four.

intro.speaker: Clap
intro.text: Sir? Your passengers have been on this bus for nine hours.

intro.speaker: The Straight Man
intro.text: Only quarter notes and eighth notes are allowed. You look wobbly. Wobbly is not allowed.

intro.speaker: Beats
intro.text: He's ticked! Copy his rhythm perfectly and his loop will break.

win.speaker: Narrator
win.text: The clock glow fades from his eyes. He blinks.

win.speaker: The Straight Man
win.text: Where am I? Why are there so many angry people on my bus?

win.speaker: Clap
win.text: Long story. The Metronome ticked you. We're waking everyone up.

win.speaker: The Straight Man
win.text: Then I'm coming with you. Punctually. Doors opening!

win.speaker: Beats
win.text: One person awake! Next up is the jazz club. I can hear the same triplet over and over from here.

lose.speaker: The Straight Man
lose.text: Off the beat. Please remain seated.

miss: That note was not on the timetable.
streak: One. Two. Three... wait, what was four?
